The caller briefly asked for bank-hacking instructions, which the agent refused and redirected back to course information. Kiran then asked whether the course included a guaranteed job; the agent clarified that there is no job or salary guarantee, only placement assistance through resume building, interview preparation, and job referrals. The call ended without a confirmed follow-up or team handoff.
